booking_drafts_held_requires_expires_at.name: booking_drafts_held_requires_expires_at
booking_drafts_held_requires_expires_at.value: "booking_drafts"."status" NOT IN ('HELD', 'PAYMENT_PROCESSING') OR "booking_drafts"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL

idempotency_records_pending_no_response.name: idempotency_records_pending_no_response
idempotency_records_pending_no_response.value: "idempotency_records"."status" <> 'PENDING' OR ("idempotency_records"."resource_id" IS NULL AND "idempotency_records"."response_status_code" IS NULL AND "idempotency_records"."response_body" IS NULL AND "idempotency_records"."completed_at" IS NULL)

idempotency_records_completed_has_resour.name: idempotency_records_completed_has_resource
idempotency_records_completed_has_resour.value: "idempotency_records"."status" <> 'COMPLETED' OR ("idempotency_records"."resource_id" IS NOT NULL AND "idempotency_records"."response_status_code" IS NOT NULL AND "idempotency_records"."response_body" IS NOT NULL AND "idempotency_records"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

idempotency_records_failed_has_response.name: idempotency_records_failed_has_response
idempotency_records_failed_has_response.value: "idempotency_records"."status" <> 'FAILED' OR ("idempotency_records"."response_status_code" IS NOT NULL AND "idempotency_records"."response_body" IS NOT NULL AND "idempotency_records"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "idempotency_records"."resource_id" IS NULL)

inventory_items_organization_serial_acti.name: inventory_items_organization_serial_active_unique
inventory_items_organization_serial_acti.where: "inventory_items"."serial_number" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_items"."deleted_at" IS NULL

payment_attempts_provider_status_with_in.name: payment_attempts_provider_status_with_intent
payment_attempts_provider_status_with_in.value: "payment_attempts"."provider_payment_intent_id" IS NULL OR "payment_attempts"."provider_status" IS NOT NULL
